M1: Original accepted XML, task, controls, full timestep CSVs; separate independent initial states
figure_eight: New single segment four-tendon design. New independent task and solved full timestep recording. M4 unchanged.
P3: Original three segments and two passive fixed-payout tendons. plus_x and minus_x accepted records sampled for display only. No integration.
visuals: scene.xml adds only density=0 contype=0 conaffinity=0 group=3 geometry, lights and colors. robot.xml is physics baseline.
v2_origin: All tasks are existing Codex-assisted engineering/tool results or existing experiments, not Main autonomous Study. No v2 design search, mathematical optimization, Main/Reporter/Provider or physics integration.
M2: Original zero/positive/negative XML, tasks, control and full physical-step trajectories; direct world force at payload COM.
M3: Original 0.5 s development draft; last 50 ms hold only.
M4: Original 0.6 s legacy timed polyline; dense peak 12.095 mm, not optimized in v2.
M5: Original transient position + tool-axis pointing; no roll or hold. Original floor collision retained; scene hides that plane visually and adds a no-collision display floor at -0.10 m to reveal the downward pointer.
M6: Original 20 g rigid payload and full inertia; original oriented scan without surface contact.
C1: Original four-tendon robot, four independent M1_A/M1_B/M1_C/M5 experiments; no global minimum or superiority claim.
PHS2D: Original 9 x 8-cell passive design and 4 tendons. 10 loading cases + equilibrium, each 401 original states sampled at 100 Hz from states_timestep.npz. No interpolation. Original dataset/evaluations and matching sampled force schedules retained.
